adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd`, but it is never set back to `false` on successful validation/mutation. The `onSuccess` handler resets `multiEmailValue` and closes the dialog (`setIsOpenDialog(false)`), but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`. Since the dialog component stays mounted in `BookingListItem` (it’s always rendered and controlled by `isOpenDialog`), reopening it after a prior validation error will still show the error message.
